props.title: How a booking works
props.description: Here's every step of booking a live band, from the first email to the final invoice, including what comes with the contract and the run of show.

props.title: How to hire a live band for your event.
props.lede: You've got a date on the calendar, and now you're wondering what happens after you reach out. Here's each step, who does it and how long it usually takes.

props.html: Booking a band, step by step

These timings assume your event is about six months away. If your event is only three weeks away, we'll go through the same steps in the same order, just faster. Planning a wedding? Here's our take on how far ahead to book wedding musicians in Colorado.

cells.html: We reply with availability and an itemized quote. Want the event captured? Add photos or video and it goes on the same contract
We send the contract, the certificate of insurance, the W-9 and the invoice in one email
3. We introduce your point of contact
You'll get the name and cell number of your personal point of contact for the event
4. You send the run of show
We add the band's part and send it back
We make sure one person is in charge of each moment in the program
They confirm the power, the stage, the load-in route and any decibel cap
We set up, check the sound and hand the space back to you, ready to go
You can reach your contact from load-in to load-out
We send one page, with every charge on its own line

props.html: Wondering about the deposit, when the balance is due or how to pay? Take a look at our FAQ. Want load-in and sound check times by band size, along with the six things to confirm with your venue? Check out our guide to what we need from your venue.
Three things we need from you
Six of those nine steps need nothing from you at all. The other three do, and if those run late, they can hold up your booking.

rows.term: The date and the venue, to get a number
rows.text: If you haven't chosen a venue yet, just give us the city. We can price your event now and update it once you've signed with a venue.

rows.term: The venue name, for the certificate of insurance
rows.text: The certificate names your venue as additional insured, so we can't issue it until you've chosen one.

rows.term: The run of show, whenever you have one
rows.text: Send us the draft, even if it's nowhere near final. We're happy to add the band's part to whatever you have, even if you haven't booked us yet.

props.html: Plans change all the time, whether it's the guest count, the program or even the venue. Just let us know and we'll update your quote. Need more time, a smaller band or a different date? We'll work it out with you.
If a musician can't make your date, we'll tell you who's stepping in and why as soon as we know.

props.title: Send us the date and the venue.
props.lede: That's enough for us to come back with a number.
